title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover social activities and campus spaces at Boston University that require no admission fees or purchases, from iconic outdoor lawns to cultural galleries and student-only wellness perks.

cards.title: Lounge at the BU Beach
cards.subtitle: Warren Alpert Mall
cards.notes: Relax on this grassy knoll behind Marsh Chapel; it is a prime spot for sunbathing and frisbee without any cost.
cards.short_summary: The BU Beach is a central campus lawn used for social gatherings and outdoor relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: The BU Beach is open 24/7, 365 days a year, and students are free to access and enjoy the space at any time.
cards.source_title: A Day at the (BU) Beach | BU Today
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 to the public and students; no reservation or fee required for casual use.

cards.entity_name: Faye G., Jo, and James Stone Gallery
cards.title: View Art at Stone Gallery
cards.subtitle: 855 Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Explore rotating contemporary art exhibitions in this professional gallery space located within the College of Fine Arts.
cards.short_summary: A professional exhibition space at BU featuring works by world-renowned artists and student thesis projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Faye G., Jo, and James Stone Gallery has free admission and is open to the public.
cards.source_title: Faye G., Jo, and James Stone Gallery | College of Fine Arts
cards.access_notes: Open to the public during gallery hours; no tickets or purchase required.

cards.title: Join Coffee & Conversation
cards.subtitle: Howard Thurman Center
cards.notes: Participate in weekly Friday discussions about current events and social issues in a structured, inclusive environment.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing BU tradition of public dialogue and civil discourse held every Friday afternoon.
cards.evidence_claim: Coffee & Conversation is a free program open to all members of the BU community every Friday from 3:30pm to 5:00pm.
cards.source_title: Coffee & Conversation | Howard Thurman Center for Common Ground
cards.access_notes: Held Fridays 3:30 PM - 5:00 PM during the academic year; open to all BU students and staff.

cards.title: Swim at the FitRec Lazy River
cards.subtitle: 915 Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Full-time students can use the competition pool and lazy river for recreation without paying a membership fee.
cards.short_summary: BU's primary fitness facility offers free access to pools and gym equipment for full-time students.
cards.evidence_claim: Membership for full-time students at Boston University is free and included in tuition.
cards.access_notes: Requires a valid BU Terrier Card for entry; available during standard facility operating hours.

cards.title: Watch a Booth Theatre Play
cards.subtitle: 820 Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Attend high-quality student theatre and opera productions for free by showing your university identification at the door.
cards.short_summary: A state-of-the-art performance space offering free admission to the BU community for School of Theatre shows.
cards.evidence_claim: All Boston University students, faculty, and staff receive free admission at the door with their BU ID to attend performances at Booth Theatre.
cards.source_title: Joan & Edgar Booth Theatre | College of Fine Arts
cards.access_notes: Free admission is subject to availability at the door; bring a valid BU ID.

cards.title: Study at Mugar Library
cards.subtitle: 771 Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Utilize seven floors of study space, including a 24-hour computer lounge during finals, at no extra cost.
cards.short_summary: The main research library for the Charles River Campus, providing extensive free study areas for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Mugar Memorial Library is open to all students with a valid BU ID and offers various open study spaces.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; 24-hour access typically provided during final exam periods for students with BU ID.

cards.title: Gather at Marsh Plaza
cards.subtitle: 735 Commonwealth Avenue
cards.notes: Visit the heart of campus to see the Martin Luther King Jr. memorial or participate in outdoor university events.
cards.short_summary: A central plaza featuring the university seal and serving as a major hub for student gatherings and traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Marsh Plaza is a public campus space used for various free community events and religious life programming.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space; specific events like Community Dinners are free for students.

cards.title: Relax in Ziskind Lounge
cards.subtitle: George Sherman Union, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Enjoy views of the Charles River from this spacious lounge located inside the student union building.
cards.short_summary: A large, comfortable lounge area in the George Sherman Union used for studying and social meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ziskind Lounge is a 7,000 square foot space in the GSU available for student use and events.
cards.access_notes: Open during GSU building hours; generally accessible to all students and visitors.

cards.title: Visit The Castle
cards.subtitle: 225 Bay State Road
cards.notes: Step inside this historic Tudor Revival mansion to admire the architecture or attend free university-hosted receptions.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus landmark that serves as an alumni center and venue for university events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dahod Family Alumni Center at the Castle is a university-owned space that hosts various free community and alumni events.
cards.source_title: Dahod Family Alumni Center at the Castle
cards.access_notes: Primarily an event space; access is free for specific university-sanctioned events and receptions.

cards.title: Make Art at Create Space
cards.subtitle: Marsh Chapel Lower Level
cards.notes: Drop in on Tuesday afternoons for free, simple art projects designed to help students de-stress through creativity.
cards.short_summary: A weekly mindfulness and art program provided for free to the BU student community.
cards.evidence_claim: Create Space is held Tuesdays from 12-2 pm and offers simple, creative art projects for students at no cost.
cards.access_notes: Tuesdays 12:00 PM - 2:00 PM during the academic year; open to all students.
